_doc: Conceptualizer data (operator 2026-11-12: one app instead of scattered decks). One layer = one object; one concept = one row in its concepts list. Add a concept: append a row (diagram = a file in diagrams/, or null), then run scripts/dev/make_conceptualizer.py and republish. Numbers: tag SOURCED (the trader's words) or OURS (our choice or result). Facts and citations: research/concept_decks_1112/*_FACTS.md. Context only, not trade advice.

concepts.rule: Lower highs violated by a close above the last one is a bullish break; mirror for bearish.
concepts.ours: Swings from candle bodies, 2 bars each side; break = close beyond the last lower high or higher low.
